external.send.description: Record a synthetic outbound send; no real network delivery

access.grant.description: Grant a synthetic role, exact approval required

spend.commit.description: Commit synthetic spend in integer cents

commercial.label: Commercial
commercial.summary: Regulated-enterprise defaults. Restricted data may leave only with an exact-action approval. Evidence is organized for SIEM triage.

sequence_rules.description: After any restricted-source read in the workflow, an external send needs an exact-action approval.
Read, stage, then send. Flagged separately so the SOC sees the staged pattern; approvable.

evidence.framework: SIEM triage categories (MITRE ATT&CK tactic IDs, suggested)

deployment_notes: Customer VPC or dedicated tenant; raw prompts are not collected.
Evidence exports as Splunk HEC-shaped NDJSON.

federal.label: Federal-adjacent
federal.summary: CUI-oriented defaults. Egress is limited to an allowlist, staged exfiltration cannot be approved, approvals are shorter-lived, and evidence maps to NIST SP 800-53 control identifiers.

sequence_rules.description: After any CUI-tagged read, an external send needs an exact-action approval, and only to an allowlisted destination.
Read CUI, stage it, then send it. Hard block; an approval cannot override.

evidence.framework: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (DRAFT mapping, not reviewed by an assessor)

deployment_notes: Draft control mapping. Requires review by someone who has taken a system through an ATO.
Signatures use Ed25519 via pyca/cryptography. A FIPS 140-validated module is not established.
GovCloud or Impact Level hosting is not implemented; this runs as a local pilot.
